title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Pavilion - University of California on 1973-11-17

ai_review.summary: A superb soundboard recording of the November 17‑1973 UCLA show, praised for its crystal‑clear mix and a jaw‑dropping Playing In The Band → Uncle John’s Band → Morning Dew sequence.
ai_review.review: The fans rave about this tight, deliberate 1973 performance, especially the soaring PITB–Uncle John’s Band–Morning Dew medley that many call one of the band’s finest moments.  The SirMick‑handed soundboard transfer is described as flawless and “fab,” making the show a must‑have for collectors.

ai_rating.rationale: All detailed reviews award five stars, praising both the musical execution (tight set, standout PITB sequence) and the flawless soundboard mix; the consistency across many reviewers yields a near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers give five stars for the mix, calling it crisp, fab, and masterful; no dropouts or balance issues are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows seamlessly, highlighted by an epic PITB → Uncle John’s Band → Morning Dew sequence that showcases the band's tightness and improvisational depth.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar tone is repeatedly praised as perfect and “broken angel sings from a guitar.”
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned visually (beard) but no specific performance comment.
